title: Data roadmap
intro: Subscriber-funded dataset and capacity queue for pillar 1 (data, compute, news). Story lives on /docs/roadmap.
disclaimer: Direction and funding targets—not a delivery schedule, and not investment advice.

items.title: Theme / ticker screener
items.description: Find new themes and tickers inflecting early—momentum, revisions, and setup

items.title: Engineering: real-time stock data platform
items.description: Design and build the streaming/websocket + normalization layer for live quotes and tape—infra, vendors, and reliability so dashboards and Blast Radius can consume RT prices.

items.title: NewsAPI.AI -- real-time, full-context news across 150k sources
items.description: Lower-cost news layer for breadth before heavier feeds.

items.title: Country trade-flow matrix (UN Comtrade / ITC)
items.description: Country–commodity dependency matrix: % of oil/gas/rare earths/semis/food from source countries; map shocks to importers; tie to themes via business_info country fields (plan §6).

items.title: Quartr — deeper transcript / catalyst pipeline
items.description: Throughput and structured catalyst extraction for event scoring.

items.title: Quiver Quantitative — Tickerized Government Spending
items.description: Maps U.S. federal contract awards and obligations to publicly traded tickers, enabling company-level tracking of government spending, contract wins, agency exposure, and spend acceleration. Useful for identifying government-driven revenue trends before earnings.

items.title: Commodity exposure matrix (company-level)
items.description: Net producer/consumer/neutral per major commodity with COGS linkage; direct scoring for commodity shocks (plan §12).

items.title: Regulatory pipeline (FDA / FCC / EPA) via FiscalNote
items.description: PDUFA, advisory committees, spectrum, emissions rules; pre-load registry with dated decisions via FiscalNote (plan §14).

items.title: S&P Panjiva — supply chain & shipment intelligence
items.description: Global trade flows, suppliers, buyers, and shipment-level context; complements Comtrade and chokepoint mapping for Blast Radius supply-chain scenarios.

items.title: TickerTrends — Google Trends and other online sentiment
items.description: Shows google trends, clickstream data, reddit trends to provide tickerized social sentiment across the web

items.title: Patent / IP clustering (USPTO, Google Patents)
items.description: Similarity and tech-area concentration for moat and obsolescence scenarios (plan §15).

items.title: Workforce data (hiring / layoffs)
items.description: Systematic headcount and role signals by ticker and geo; leading indicator for capacity vs retrenchment (plan §16).

items.title: News entity graph
items.description: Knowledge graph from news pipeline: companies, people, countries, policies—narrative linkages beyond theme adjacency (plan §19).

items.title: Performance & refactor capacity
items.description: Contractor time for large-dashboard refactor and latency (Phase 0).

items.title: Bloomberg Terminal
items.description: Professional Terminal—real-time data, news, analytics, messaging (~$24k/year/seat order of magnitude).

items.title: Satellite / geospatial validation
items.description: Ports, plants, foot traffic—validate event impact in near real time; high ROI bar (plan §18).

items.title: USASpending.gov — federal contracts
items.description: Rebuild home version of Quiver Quant w/ contracts by company, agency, $, type; defense and policy-scenario scoring (plan §13).

items.title: Reddit / social event sourcing
items.description: Rebuild home version of Ticker Trends. Key subreddits + engagement filters; LLM extracts events, dedupes registry, scores novel narratives (plan §10).

items.title: Hire a backend engineer
items.description: Full-time capacity for data pipelines, infra, and reliability.

items.title: Visible Alpha — segment & estimate depth
items.description: Deeper sell-side–style segment models and consensus detail where available.

items.title: AlphaSense — sell-side research & search
items.description: Broker research, expert calls, unified search across internal docs.

items.title: Hire an AI / research analyst
items.description: Dedicated support for LLM workflows, QA, and research tooling.

items.title: Credit card / alt transaction data
items.description: Spend acceleration by merchant category and geo; consumer names and event validation (plan §17).

items.title: Hire a webscraper
items.description: Full-time capacity to find web data
